question:
Choose the correct option to complete the sentence.

The hospital staff ensured proper _______ condition is every ward
solution:
The correct answer is '**sanitary**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**sanitary**" means clean and hygienic, especially to prevent disease. (स्वच्छ)
 
• The hospital staff ensures that sanitary conditions are maintained to promote health and safety.
 
• The other options: "**sanity**," "**sanitarium**," and "**sanitery**" do not fit the context correctly.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The hospital staff ensured proper sanitary__ condition in every ward.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sanity (समझदारी)**: Refers to the state of having a sound mind.
 
• **Sanitarium (स्वास्थ्यगृह)**: Refers to a medical facility for long-term illness, typically tuberculosis.
 
• **Sanitery**: This is a misspelled version of the word "sanitary."
